example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কইমাছের প্রাণ, কোনো কষ্টেই ভাঙে না।
এই গাছের কইমাছের প্রাণ, শুকিয়ে গেলেও আবার ফুটে ওঠে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has the life of a koi fish; no hardship breaks him.
This tree has the tenacity of a koi fish; it revives even after drying up.
history: The idiom draws from the observation that koi fish (Climbing perch) can survive out of water for extended periods by breathing air, symbolizing remarkable endurance in Bengali rural folklore.
note: The koi fish is native to Bengali wetlands, emphasizing cultural ties to local ecology.
